heading.en: Background and career to 1937

body.zh-Hant: 畑俊六（1879–1962）出生於東京，是陸軍士官學校第12期，並畢業於陸軍大學校。1900年11月自士官學校畢業後，他歷任第14師團長、航空本部長、台灣軍司令官與教育總監等要職，1937年晉升陸軍大將。
body.en: Hata Shunroku (1879–1962) was born in Tokyo, a graduate of the 12th class of the Army Officers School and of the Army War College. After graduating in November 1900 he held posts including commander of the 14th Division, chief of the Army Air Headquarters, commander of the Taiwan Army and Inspector General of Military Training, and became a full general in 1937.

heading.zh-Hant: 中支那派遣軍與徐州、武漢作戰
heading.en: Central China Expeditionary Army: Xuzhou and Wuhan

body.zh-Hant: 1938年2月14日，畑俊六就任新編成的中支那派遣軍司令官，當時日中戰事已由華北波及華中。他在任不足一年，指導了1938年4月至6月的徐州會戰，以及同年6月至10月的武漢攻略作戰。
body.en: On 14 February 1938 Hata took command of the newly formed Central China Expeditionary Army, when the fighting had spread from North China to Central China. In less than a year in command he directed the Battle of Xuzhou (April–June 1938) and the Wuhan offensive (June–October 1938).

heading.zh-Hant: 陸軍大臣與米內內閣倒台
heading.en: Army Minister and the fall of the Yonai cabinet

body.zh-Hant: 中支那派遣軍司令官之後，畑俊六出任阿部內閣與米內內閣的陸軍大臣。首相官邸資料顯示阿部內閣於1939年8月30日成立，米內內閣的在職期間至1940年7月22日。1940年他為推動近衛新體制而單獨辭職，米內內閣因此倒台。
body.en: After commanding in Central China, Hata served as Army Minister in the Abe and Yonai cabinets. The Prime Minister's Office records the Abe cabinet as formed on 30 August 1939 and the Yonai cabinet as in office until 22 July 1940. In 1940 he resigned alone to establish the Konoe new order, which brought down the Yonai cabinet.

heading.zh-Hant: 支那派遣軍、第2總軍與戰後
heading.en: China Expeditionary Army, Second General Army and after the war

body.zh-Hant: 1941年畑俊六出任支那派遣軍總司令官，1944年晉升元帥。1945年4月7日，他就任負責防衛西日本的第2總軍司令官，直到終戰。戰後他在遠東國際軍事審判被判終身刑，1954年因病假釋，1958年獲赦免。
body.en: In 1941 Hata became commander-in-chief of the China Expeditionary Army and in 1944 was made a field marshal. On 7 April 1945 he took command of the Second General Army, responsible for the defence of western Japan, and remained there until the end of the war. After the war the International Military Tribunal for the Far East sentenced him to life imprisonment; he was released on parole in 1954 owing to illness and pardoned in 1958.

heading.en: Birth and succession to the Kan'in house

body.zh-Hant: 閑院宮載仁親王於慶應元年（1865年）9月22日誕生，是伏見宮邦家親王的第十四男子，幼名易宮。1872年（明治5年）他繼承四親王家之一的閑院宮，十一年獲賜載仁之名並受親王宣下。
body.en: Prince Kan'in Kotohito was born on 22 September 1865, the fourteenth son of Prince Fushimi-no-miya Kuniie, with the childhood name Yasu-no-miya. In 1872 he succeeded to the Kan'in house, one of the four shinnō houses, and in the eleventh year (of Meiji) was given the name Kotohito and the rank of imperial prince.

heading.en: Study in France, the Sino-Japanese and Russo-Japanese wars

body.zh-Hant: 載仁親王自陸軍幼年學校畢業後，於1882年9月獲准自費赴法留學，十月十二日由橫濱啟程。他在法國入讀聖西爾陸軍士官學校與索米爾騎兵學校，後來因日清戰爭以第一軍司令部附出征，日露戰爭時出征並任陸軍中將，其後歷任第一師團長、近衛師團長，大正元年任陸軍大將、軍事參議官。
body.en: After graduating from the Army Cadet School, Prince Kotohito was permitted in September 1882 to study in France at his own expense and left Yokohama on 12 October. He entered the Saint-Cyr military academy and the Saumur cavalry school, went to the front attached to the First Army headquarters in the Sino-Japanese War, served in the Russo-Japanese War as a lieutenant general, then commanded the 1st Division and the Imperial Guard Division, and in the first year of Taishō became a full general and military councillor.

heading.en: Field marshal and Chief of the General Staff

body.zh-Hant: 載仁親王於1919年12月列入元帥府，1921年（大正10年）隨皇太子裕仁親王赴歐洲巡遊。昭和6年他出任參謀總長，在任期間涵蓋滿洲事變到支那事變的時期；陸軍參謀本部資料顯示，杉山元自1940年10月3日起擔任參謀總長。
body.en: Prince Kotohito was placed on the Board of Field Marshals in December 1919 and in 1921 accompanied Crown Prince Hirohito on his tour of Europe. He became Chief of the General Staff in the sixth year of Shōwa (1931), serving through the period from the Manchurian Incident to the China Incident; a staff-roster page of the Army General Staff records Sugiyama Hajime as Chief of the General Staff from 3 October 1940.

heading.en: Service in the Sino-Japanese and Russo-Japanese war campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 載仁親王的年表記載，在日清戰役（日清戰爭）之際，他以第一軍司令部附的身分出征；日露戰爭時再度出征，並升任陸軍中將。《20世紀日本人名事典》則記他明治34年任騎兵第2旅團長，之後從軍日露戰爭，其後歷任第1師團長、近衛師團長，大正元年升陸軍大將並任軍事參議官。
body.en: His chronology records that at the time of the Sino-Japanese War campaign he went to the front attached to the First Army headquarters, and that he served again in the Russo-Japanese War, being promoted lieutenant general. A biographical dictionary adds that he became commander of the 2nd Cavalry Brigade in 1901, served in the Russo-Japanese War, then commanded the 1st Division and the Imperial Guard Division, and in 1912 became a full general and Military Councillor.

heading.en: Origins, the Northern Expedition and the Guangxi base

body.zh-Hant: 李宗仁（1890–1969）生於廣西省臨桂縣，畢業於廣西陸軍學堂。1926年他隨北伐加入國民革命軍，任第7軍軍長。北伐完成後蔣介石任命他為武漢政治分會主席與第4集團軍總司令，但1929年起兩人對立，他與白崇禧在廣西割據八年。
body.en: Li Zongren (1890–1969) was born in Linguei county, Guangxi, and graduated from the Guangxi Army School. In 1926 he joined the National Revolutionary Army in the Northern Expedition as commander of the 7th Army. After the expedition Chiang Kai-shek appointed him chairman of the Wuhan Political Council and commander of the 4th Group Army, but from 1929 the two were at odds and he held Guangxi with Bai Chongxi for eight years.

heading.en: The Fifth War Zone in the war against Japan

body.zh-Hant: 1937年起的日中戰爭中，李宗仁與蔣介石和解並協助抗日，擔任第五戰區總司令。1945年以後，他又任華北戰區司令長官，指揮國共內戰。
body.en: In the war with Japan from 1937 Li Zongren was reconciled with Chiang Kai-shek, cooperated in the resistance and served as commander-in-chief of the Fifth War Zone. After 1945 he also served as commander of the North China theatre and directed operations in the civil war.

heading.en: Vice-president, acting president and exile

body.zh-Hant: 1948年5月20日，蔣介石與李宗仁就任第一任總統、副總統。1949年1月21日蔣引退，李宗仁代行職權，與共產黨交涉但決裂，同年12月5日他飛往美國。1950年3月蔣復行視事，1954年3月10日國民大會投票罷免副總統李宗仁，1965年7月20日他回到中國大陸。
body.en: On 20 May 1948 Chiang Kai-shek and Li Zongren took office as the first president and vice-president. When Chiang stepped down on 21 January 1949 Li exercised the presidential powers and negotiated with the Communists without success, and on 5 December 1949 he flew to the United States. Chiang resumed office in March 1950, the National Assembly voted on 10 March 1954 to remove vice-president Li, and on 20 July 1965 he returned to mainland China.

heading.en: The Northern Expedition and the Battle of Taierzhuang

body.zh-Hant: 李宗仁在1926年起的北伐中擔任國民革命軍第7軍軍長參加北伐，據《百科事典マイペディア》，北伐時他任第3路軍總指揮兼第7軍長。日中戰爭期間，他任安徽省主席與第5戰區總司令，並在台兒莊戰役中取得大勝。
body.en: Li Zongren took part in the Northern Expedition from 1926 as commander of the 7th Army, and a Japanese encyclopedia says he was general commander of the 3rd Route Army as well. During the war with Japan he was governor of Anhui and commander-in-chief of the Fifth War Zone, winning a major victory at Taierzhuang.

heading.en: Origins, the Northern Expedition and the Guangxi clique

body.zh-Hant: 白崇禧（1893–1966）為廣西桂林人，1916年畢業於保定軍官學校。1926年他任國民革命軍總司令部參謀長，次年（1927年）北伐時任東路軍前敵總指揮。1928年起，他與李宗仁等鞏固廣西派的地盤，並與蔣介石對立。
body.en: Bai Chongxi (1893–1966) was from Guilin in Guangxi and graduated from the Baoding Military Academy in 1916. In 1926 he became chief of staff of the National Revolutionary Army headquarters and in 1927, in the Northern Expedition, commander at the front of the Eastern Route Army. From 1928 he consolidated the Guangxi clique's base with Li Zongren and others and was at odds with Chiang Kai-shek.

body.zh-Hant: 1930年白崇禧參加反蔣運動，妥協後於1931年成為國民黨第4期中央執行委員。盧溝橋事變發生後他飛赴中央，就任軍事委員會副參謀總長。1938年11月，他出任桂林行營主任，指揮桂南會戰，一度攻下崑崙關，但日軍增援後崑崙關再度失守。
body.en: In 1930 Bai joined the anti-Chiang movement and, after a compromise, became a member of the Fourth Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang in 1931. After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident he flew to the capital and became deputy chief of the General Staff of the Military Affairs Commission. In November 1938 he became director of the Guilin Field Headquarters and directed the southern Guangxi campaign, at one point taking Kunlun Pass before it fell again once Japan sent reinforcements.

heading.en: Defence Minister, the 228 Incident and Taiwan

body.zh-Hant: 白崇禧自1946年起任國防部長，國防部中文頁面載明任期為民國35年5月31日至37年5月31日。1947年3月11日國民政府派他赴台處理二二八事件，3月17日他抵台。他在1949年任華中軍政長官，敗退後轉往台灣，1950年起任國民黨中央委員。
body.en: From 1946 Bai Chongxi was Minister of National Defense; the ministry's Chinese-language page gives his term as 31 May 1946 to 31 May 1948. On 11 March 1947 the National Government sent him to Taiwan to handle the 228 Incident and he arrived on 17 March. He became Central China military governor in 1949, withdrew to Taiwan after defeat and from 1950 was a member of the Kuomintang Central Committee.

body.zh-Hant: 蔣中正，字介石，1887年生於浙江奉化，青年赴日本學習軍事，畢業於振武學校。辛亥革命時他協助陳其美，陳去世後直接追隨孫中山。1923年受命為大元帥行營參謀長，1924年擔任黃埔陸軍軍官學校校長。
body.en: Chiang Kai-shek, courtesy name Jieshi, was born in 1887 in Fenghua, Zhejiang. As a young man he went to Japan to study military affairs and graduated from the Shinbu Gakko. During the 1911 Revolution he assisted Chen Qimei and, after Chen's death, followed Sun Yat-sen directly. In 1923 he was appointed chief of staff of the generalissimo's field headquarters and in 1924 became principal of the Whampoa Military Academy.

body.en: After the Zhongshan gunboat incident in March 1926 Chiang gradually took full military authority in the National Government; in July of that year he became commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army and launched the Northern Expedition. The Central Plains War of 1930 ended in his victory, and after the Mukden Incident he resigned the chairmanship to promote unity and left the capital.

body.zh-Hant: 1948年4月，第一屆國民大會選舉蔣中正為行憲後首任總統，他於5月20日就職。1949年初下野，1950年3月復行視事。總統府資料載明他的任期為1948年5月20日至1975年4月5日，國史館資料則記他於1975年4月5日病逝臺北。
body.en: In April 1948 the first National Assembly elected Chiang the first president under the constitution and he took office on 20 May. He stepped down in early 1949 and resumed office in March 1950. The Office of the President records his term as 20 May 1948 to 5 April 1975, and the Academia Historica records that he died in Taipei on 5 April 1975.

heading.en: The Northern Expedition and later campaigns

body.zh-Hant: 1926年7月，蔣中正就任國民革命軍總司令並下達北伐令，率軍北上進行反軍閥戰爭。1929至1930年各地軍閥發動反蔣戰爭，他予以鎮壓，之後展開對共產黨革命根據地的大規模包圍攻擊。1937年國共合作的抗日戰爭開始，1938年武漢失守後，他以重慶為根據地。
body.en: In July 1926 Chiang Kai-shek took office as commander-in-chief of the National Revolutionary Army and issued the order for the Northern Expedition, a campaign against the warlords. He put down the anti-Chiang wars of 1929-30 and then launched large-scale encirclement campaigns against the Communist base areas. The war of resistance began in 1937 under the Kuomintang-Communist cooperation, and after the fall of Wuhan in 1938 he based himself at Chongqing.
